headline: Glassy dawn then SW cross-on takes over — not a 3hr day.
today: Light WSW at dawn gives a short clean window before the SW cross-on stacks up to 13mph and stays there. Good angle and some size on the sets early, but you'd need to be local to catch the good part. Not worth the drive.

daysToWatch.note: Cross-off in the morning with a fair S angle up to 2.8ft — cleanest Matunuck gets midweek, but short-period.
Prime ESE angle and size, but 15mph ESE cross wind all day chops it up.
